test_case.test_name: GNR transient DDR C/A parity alert and firmware-first logging
test_case.purpose: Prove one transient command/address parity event on the intended channel asserts the mapped controller alert/MCA path and produces the expected ELog after recovery.
required_package: Approved Intel CScripts/injectCMDParity configuration and FAE
Clean/asserted MC shadow, alertsignal, bank13/status/extlog decoder
Dedicated SUT, serial/OOB and halt/go crash recovery
test_case.test_command: Qualified operator preserves logs/settings, proves approved target registers clean, arms trace, executes one halt/resetInjector/injectCMDParity(socket=0,mc=0,ch=0), captures asserted MC shadow/alertsignal, executes go once, correlates serial, MCA bank13/status and timestamped extlog_mem_event, then restores settings and verifies health.
test_case.expected_result: Only the mapped channel reports the approved transient parity alert and MCA signature; resume succeeds, matching extlog_mem_event appears, no fatal/wrong-target event occurs, and the system returns healthy after restoration.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires immutable target/harness identity, clean-to-asserted register transition, correct bank13/status and extlog correlation, healthy resume and restoration. Wrong target/severity, missing alert/ELog, hang or recovery failure fails/blocks.
safety_gate: Explicit critical injection approval on an isolated SUT.
Preserve evidence; clear only approved volatile target state after baseline.
One injection/go only; stop on wrong channel or severity.
No automatic retry/reboot or inferred register values.
expected_evidence: Single injection and asserted MC/alert state
test_case.recovery: On wrong target, fatal escalation or hang, preserve serial/register evidence and use approved OOB recovery without reinjection; restore parity/trace/DFX/GRUB settings and verify memory health.
